case_name: Mallikarjunappa K M vs Smt. C.S.Mala

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Mallikarjunappa K M, husband, Assistant Director / Deputy Chief, University Employment Information & Guidance Bureau
parties.respondent_defendant: Smt. C.S.Mala, wife, residing at Mysuru - 570023

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Appellant and respondent got married in 1998. Initially they had a happy life. Appellant took respondent to her parental home and requested her to stay there. Respondent used to insult and quarrel with appellant, threatening suicide.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party alleging cruelty to prove the same.
legal_principles.held: It is averred that during her second pregnancy doctor had advised her to take rest and not to travel ignoring such advise she went to her parental home.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not interfere with the findings of the Family Court unless there is a manifest error.
legal_principles.held: We have considered the submissions made by learned counsel for the appellant and respondent and have perused the records.

outcome.final_order: Petition filed by the appellant seeking dissolution of marriage was dismissed.
